===Marley===
'''Items required:''' a [[knife]], [[cooked meat]] and [[bread]].
{{Checklist|*Speak to [[Marley]] in [[Edgeville]] at the yew trees. You MUST speak to Marley first or the cook wont give you the recipe.
*Speak to the [[Cook (Blue Moon Inn)|cook]] in the east room of [[Blue Moon Inn]] in Varrock. He will give you the steak sandwich recipe. {{Chat option|1I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwich?}}
*Create a [[steak sandwich]] by using a [[knife]] on [[cooked meat]] while having [[bread]] in your inventory.
*Speak to [[Marley]] in [[Edgeville]] at the yew trees with the steak sandwich in your inventory.}}
